findings.title: Fit-only finalizer does not revalidate durable receipt.inputs
findings.evidence_kind: static source/data-flow trace, not runtime reproduction
findings.impact: A receipt whose mandatory inputs map was deleted or changed after phase_done can be promoted to executed while package/consumed/planned digest strings remain unchanged.
findings.minimum_fix: Apply the shared external-input binding validator to the exact durable fit receipt snapshot before ledger mutation, retaining plan/package/consumed comparisons and v2 behavior.

evidence_limit: Submitted preserved logs verified; reviewer did not rerun tests or observe remote processes.
note: Preserve round2a and prior accepted conclusions; no retroactive relabeling of past results.
